Hold one ordinary earthenware cup. No armor, weapons, noble jewelry or shield. This is only a representative household figure, no named profession.
Neutral upright three-quarter stance, feet visible, calm readable silhouette, simple large shapes. NO environment, ground plane, cast shadow, glow, text, watermark or extra person. Genuine transparent PNG outside the figure and through all open gaps. Do not copy the reference knight's standard helmet or armor; use the specified individual design.
